title: Simplifying, Stabilizing and Scaling Continuous-time Consistency Models

contributions.purpose: 统一扩散模型与一致性模型的参数化,简化连续时间CM的公式并暴露不稳定的根因
contributions.mechanism: 提出TrigFlow,一个统一EDM与Flow Matching的新formulation,大幅简化扩散模型、PF-ODE与CM的表达
contributions.evaluation: 定性/理论:基于TrigFlow分析连续时间CM训练不稳定的根因,为后续改进提供框架
contributions.domain: 扩散/一致性生成模型(图像生成)
contributions.source_quote: Our first contribution is TrigFlow, a new formulation that unifies EDM (Karras et al.,2022; 2024) and Flow Matching ..., significantly simplifying the formulation of diffusion models, the associated probability flow ODE and CMs.

contributions.purpose: 稳定连续时间CM训练(此前严重不稳定、显著逊于离散时间CM)
contributions.mechanism: 一套改进recipe:改进的time-conditioning(positional time embeddings,相当于Fourier scale≈0.02)、adaptive group normalization网络架构、重构训练目标(adaptive weighting/normalization + progressive annealing),并用JVP重排在FP16+Flash Attention下精确计算tangent
contributions.evaluation: 消融(Fig.4/5):大Fourier scale导致不稳定,positional embedding使∂对x_t和t均稳定;normalization或clipping显著改善训练;分析解释了Song&Dhariwal(2023)的观察
contributions.domain: 扩散/一致性生成模型(图像生成)
contributions.source_quote: Building on this foundation, we analyze the root causes of instability in CM training and propose a complete recipe for mitigation.

contributions.purpose: 将连续时间CM扩展到前所未有的规模并实现有竞争力的少步生成
contributions.mechanism: sCM(simplified CM),在CIFAR-10/ImageNet 64/512上训练至1.5B参数(史上最大CM),同时支持consistency training与distillation
contributions.evaluation: 2步采样FID:CIFAR-10 2.06、ImageNet 64 1.48、ImageNet 512 1.88;与最佳扩散模型FID差距缩到10%以内,且用<10%的有效采样compute
contributions.domain: 扩散/一致性生成模型(图像生成)
contributions.source_quote: These changes enable us to train continuous-time CMs at an unprecedented scale, reaching 1.5B parameters on ImageNet 512x512. Our proposed training algorithm, using only two sampling steps, achieves FID scores of 2.06 on CIFAR-10,1.48 on ImageNet 64x64,and 1.88 on ImageNet 512x512

contributions.purpose: 论证连续时间CM相对离散时间的优势,并对比sCM与VSD
contributions.mechanism: 实证:证明相邻timestep间隔缩小趋近连续时间极限时样本质量提升;比较sCM与VSD在不同guidance scale下的多样性与FID
contributions.evaluation: sCD比sCT scale更好且FID ratio跨模型尺寸恒定offset(随采样步增多减小);sCM比VSD多样性更高、更兼容guidance,VSD在高guidance下退化
contributions.domain: 扩散/一致性生成模型(图像生成)
contributions.source_quote: we provide a rigorous justification for the advantages of continuous-time CMs over discrete-time variants by demonstrating that sample quality improves as the gap between adjacent timesteps narrows to approach the continuous-time limit.

self_declared_provenance.quote: TrigFlow, a new formulation that unifies EDM (Karras et al.,2022; 2024) and Flow Matching (Peluchetti, 2022; Lipman et al., 2022; Liu et al., 2022; ...)
we build upon the TrigFlow framework and introduce several theoretically motivated improvements to stabilize continuous-time CMs
Consistency models (CMs) (Song et al., 2023; Song & Dhariwal, 2023) ... Previous work found that training continuous-time CMs ... suffers from severe instability

notes: trade-off/caveat:(1) 明确只是把与最佳扩散模型的FID gap缩到10%以内,并未超越SOTA扩散;(2) sCD(distillation)scale优于sCT(consistency training),sCT相对更弱;(3) 连续时间CM此前'significantly worse'于离散时间CM,是本文要解决的痛点;(4) VSD在高guidance退化——作为对比方法的负面,sCM相对更优。大量嫁接EDM/EDM2架构、Flow Matching、CM既有工作。
